verses.gurmukhi: ਮੂਰਖ ਤਿਸ ਨੋ ਆਖੀਐ ਬੋਲੁ ਨ ਸਮਝੈ ਬੋਲਿ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ।
verses.translit_en: moorakh tis no aakheeaai bol na samajhai bol na jaanai|

en.bdb: Foolish is he who neither understands the matter in hand nor speaks well.

verses.gurmukhi: ਹੋਰੋ ਕਿਹੁ ਕਰਿ ਪੁਛੀਐ ਹੋਰੋ ਕਿਉ ਕਰਿ ਆਖਿ ਵਖਾਣੈ।
verses.translit_en: horo kih kar puchheeaai horo kiau kar aakh vakhaanai|

en.bdb: He is asked something else and he replies altogether about something different.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਿਖ ਦੇਇ ਸਮਝਾਈਐ ਅਰਥੁ ਅਨਰਥੁ ਮਨੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਆਣੈ।
verses.translit_en: sikh dhei samajhaieeaai arath anarath manai vich aanai|

en.bdb: Ill advised, he misinterprets it and brings forth from his mind the contrary meaning.

verses.gurmukhi: ਵਡਾ ਅਸਮਝੁ ਨ ਸਮਝਈ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਵਿਹੂਣਾ ਹੋਇ ਹੈਰਾਣੈ।
verses.translit_en: vaddaa asamajh na samajhiee surat vihoonaa hoi hairaanai|

en.bdb: He is a big idiot who does not understand and being devoid of consciousness is ever surprised and confused.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਚਿਤਿ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਮਿਤ੍ਰੁ ਸਤ੍ਰੁ ਪਰਵਾਣੈ।
verses.translit_en: gurmat chit na aaviee dhuramat mitr satr paravaanai|

en.bdb: He never cherishes in his heart the wisdom of the Gum and due to his evil intellect considers his friend as a foe.

verses.gurmukhi: ਅਗਨੀ ਸਪਹੁਂ ਵਰਜੀਐ ਗੁਣ ਵਿਚਿ ਅਵਗੁਣ ਕਰੈ ਧਿਙਾਣੈ।
verses.translit_en: aganee sapahu(n) varajeeaai gun vich avagun karai dhin(g)aanai|

en.bdb: The wisdom of not going near snake and fire he takes otherwise and forcibly turns virtue into vice.
He behaves like an infant who does not recognise his mother and goes on crying and pissing.
